• Types of age spots (freckles, melasma) and treatment methods to remove age spots
  • How to prevent stains
  • Frequently asked questions about stain treatment
  • What is dull skin? self check
  • Is dryness the cause of dull skin?
  • How to improve and treat dull skin

Types of age spots (freckles, melasma) and treatment methods to remove age spots

senile pigment spot

It usually occurs after the age of 30 on areas that are exposed to ultraviolet rays on a daily basis, such as the face and backs of the hands.
It often appears as a circular, brownish stain. Also, the boundaries are clear. They vary in size.

Recommended treatment

Pico laser, photofacial, topical medicine

Freckles (sparrow egg spots)

Freckles often appear from childhood. The main cause is said to be genetic.
They appear symmetrically, centering on the cheeks and the tip of the nose. Small round spots, about 1 to 5 mm in size, are located at a near-uniform density.

Recommended treatment

Pico laser, photofacial, oral medication

melasma

From your late 20s onwards, symmetrical dark spots appear mainly on your cheeks.
Because it is caused by the influence of female hormones, it tends to improve naturally after menopause.

Recommended treatment

Photofacial, oral medication

post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

These are reddish brown spots that appear after injuries, burns, acne, and atopic dermatitis.
It tends to appear in places where there are many opportunities for friction on a daily basis.

Recommended treatment

Pico laser, vitamin injection, oral medication

ADM

This is a symmetrical dark spot that appears on the cheeks and is common among people in their 20s and 30s. It may be bluish or grayish.
It is said to be caused by aging, ultraviolet rays, and changes in hormonal balance.

Recommended treatment

Pico laser, vitamin injection

How to prevent stains

There are various causes of stains, but the following three points are common in preventing stains.

UV protection

The biggest cause of melanin pigment production is ultraviolet rays. Please be aware that UV rays are present all year round and can pass through clouds and window glass, so take measures to protect yourself from UV rays by wearing sunscreen, hats, parasols, sunglasses, etc.
Use sunscreen on exposed areas other than your face, such as the backs of your hands.
Ultraviolet rays are strongest from early spring to summer.

skin care

Dry skin leads to a decline in barrier function. Please be especially conscious of moisturizing. Moisturized skin is less susceptible to UV rays.
As we age, our metabolism also slows down. Keep your hormones balanced by eating a well-balanced diet, getting enough sleep, exercising, and relieving yourself of stress to prevent your metabolism from slowing down.

Intake of vitamin E and vitamin C

The antioxidant effect of vitamin E and the suppression of melanin pigment production by vitamin C are effective in preventing age spots.
While basic intake is through diet, incorporate supplements, beauty treatments, etc. as needed.

Frequently asked questions about stain treatment

What causes stains?

It can be caused by a variety of things, including ultraviolet rays, genetics, changes in hormonal balance, poor lifestyle habits, and stress.

I don't know which type of stain I have.

It may be difficult for patients to identify the type and cause of the stain on their own. If you take the wrong measures, you may end up making the stain worse.
We will narrow down the cause through interviews and tests, and provide appropriate advice, so please consult our clinic first.

Can stains be removed in one treatment?

If you have senile pigment spots, it may be possible to remove the spots with one treatment using laser treatment. However, it depends on the severity of the stain, so we cannot guarantee that.
Laser treatment can be repeated at intervals, so please feel free to contact us for a consultation.

Is stain removal using a laser painful?

The pain is similar to that of a rubber band, but most people can undergo it without anesthesia.
You can also use creams, tapes, etc. that contain anesthetic ingredients, so please don't worry.

Can I remove stains during pregnancy?

It is said that laser treatment has no adverse effect on the fetus. However, it is not recommended during pregnancy, as the hormonal balance changes and age spots are more likely to occur than before or after giving birth.

What is dull skin? self check

  • I look pale even with makeup on
  • Skin looks lackluster and tired
  • The skin on the face is darker than the color on the neck
  • The foundation color I always use doesn't match anymore.

This refers to a condition in which the skin loses its transparency and luster, and dark spots become noticeable.
Treatments vary depending on the cause, but with proper care, it is possible to improve the condition of your skin.

Is dryness the cause of dull skin?

drying

Dry skin has irregular texture. This texture creates fine unevenness, which creates shadows and darkens the overall skin.

ultraviolet light

Exposure to ultraviolet rays increases the production of a dark pigment called melanin. When melanin remains on the skin due to disruption of skin turnover and overproduction of melanin, it causes age spots and dullness.

poor blood circulation

Blood and lymph stagnation due to poor circulation causes waste products to accumulate. Accumulation of waste products can cause disturbances in skin turnover, which can make your complexion look pale.

accumulation of dead skin

Disturbed turnover prevents dead skin cells from being excreted, and if they remain on the skin surface, the skin becomes dull. This condition is called "keratin hyperplasia," and the skin becomes noticeably stiff.

How to improve and treat dull skin

Moisturizing care to improve turnover disorder

By replenishing moisture to the skin, it helps the skin rebuild its own turnover.
Use a lotion that contains moisturizing ingredients and cover it with emulsion or cream.

UV protection

Be sure to use sunscreen and a parasol to avoid damage from UV rays. Exposure to UV rays can also lead to dryness, so be careful not to expose yourself to excessive UV rays.

photo facial

It irradiates light called IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) to bring transparency to the skin.
It can also be effective for various skin concerns such as age spots, freckles, melasma, redness, acne/acne scars, and enlarged pores.

About photofacial

water light injection

The main ingredient is non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid, which has high moisturizing properties, and can be customized with vitamin C, placenta, CoQ10, etc.
Since it can be injected into the dermis and epidermis, it can be expected to lead to moisturized and firm skin and improve dullness. The injection is done using a very thin needle, so there is almost no pain.

About water light injection

beauty drip

We offer a variety of drips (injections), including high-concentration vitamin C drips, acne drips, placenta injections, and NMN drips. Promotes skin turnover and brings clarity.
